## Description

Testing of table interactions including data search, filtering, sorting, pagination, and data export (download). Covers all table-based functionality on the Selenium Playground.

## Pages Covered

| #   | Page Name           | URL Path               |
| --- | ------------------- | ---------------------- |
| 1   | Table Data Download | `/table-data-download` |
| 2   | Table Data Search   | `/table-data-search`   |
| 3   | Table Filter        | `/table-filter`        |
| 4   | Table Pagination    | `/table-pagination`    |
| 5   | Table Sort & Search | `/table-sort-search`   |

## What to Handle

- Table data rendering and verification
- Search functionality (by column, by text)
- Filtering by column values or criteria
- Sorting (ascending, descending) with multi-column sort
- Pagination (next, previous, page selection, page size)
- Data export/download (CSV, Excel if available)
- Pagination state persistence
- Row and cell-level assertions

## Acceptance Criteria

- ✅ All 5 table pages accessible and tables render
- ✅ Search filters table rows by text match
- ✅ Column filtering works (single and multi-column)
- ✅ Sort order toggles and affects data correctly
- ✅ Pagination navigation works (next, previous, direct page)
- ✅ Page size selection updates table display
- ✅ Data download initiates successfully
- ✅ Table row count and content verified before/after actions
- ✅ All tests use `setup('<page name>')` fixture
- ✅ Page objects created for table interactions
- ✅ Assertions separate in dedicated files

## Out of Scope

- Downloaded file content validation (file system level)
- Performance with massive datasets (10k+ rows)
- Real-time data updates from server
- Export format conversion validation
- Accessibility compliance beyond semantic structure
- Inline cell editing
